options.name: approval
options.description: Approval status of the catalog request task. Default choices are C(requested), C(approved), C(rejected), C(not requested).

options.name: assigned_to
options.description: User assigned to handle this catalog request task. Expected value is user login name (user_name field).

options.name: assignment_group
options.description: The name of the group that the catalog request task is assigned to.

options.name: attachments
options.description: ServiceNow attachments.

options.name: catalog_request_task_mapping
options.description: User mapping for I(Catalog request task) object, where user can override Choice Lists values for objects.

options.name: close_notes
options.description: Notes added when closing the catalog request task.

options.name: comments
options.description: Additional comments for the catalog request task.

options.name: delivery_plan
options.description: Delivery plan for the catalog request task.

options.name: delivery_task
options.description: Delivery task reference for the catalog request task.

options.name: description
options.description: Detailed description of the catalog request task.

options.name: due_date
options.description: Expected due date for the catalog request task. Expected format is YYYY-MM-DD.

options.name: impact
options.description: Impact of the catalog request task. Default choices are C(1), C(2), C(3). Impact 1 is the highest, 3 is the lowest impact.

options.name: instance
options.description: ServiceNow instance information.

options.name: number
options.description: Number of the record to operate on. Note that contrary to I(sys_id), I(number) may not uniquely identify a record.

options.name: order
options.description: Order/sequence number for task execution.

options.name: other
options.description: Optional remaining parameters. For more information on optional parameters, refer to the ServiceNow catalog request task documentation.

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority of the catalog request task. Default choices are C(1), C(2), C(3), C(4), C(5). Priority 1 is the highest, 5 is the lowest priority.

options.name: request
options.description: The catalog request (sc_request) this task belongs to. Can be specified as sys_id or number of the catalog request.

options.name: requested_by
options.description: User who requested the catalog item. Expected value is user login name (user_name field).

options.name: requested_for
options.description: User who the catalog item is being requested for. Expected value is user login name (user_name field).

options.name: short_description
options.description: Brief summary of the catalog request task.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the catalog request task. If I(state) value is C(present), the record is created or updated. If I(state) value is C(absent), the record is deleted. Default choices are C(present) and C(absent).

options.name: sys_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the record to operate on.

options.name: task_state
options.description: The current state of the catalog request task. Default choices are C(pending), C(open), C(work_in_progress), C(closed_complete), C(closed_incomplete), C(closed_skipped).

options.name: urgency
options.description: Urgency of the catalog request task. Default choices are C(1), C(2), C(3). Urgency 1 is the highest, 3 is the lowest urgency.

options.name: work_notes
options.description: Work notes for the catalog request task (internal notes). This field is not idempotent. Any value set here will be added to the existing work notes on the task. This field is always empty in the record returned by the module.
